migration_disabled_entry.description:
The disabled OpenWrt (ubus) entry for `{host}` was migrated to the main entry and is now polled, as subentries cannot be disabled. To stop tracking this router:

1. Delete the `{host}` subentry from the main OpenWrt (ubus) entry.
2. Remove the router's `device_tracker` YAML configuration, if any, as it re-imports the router on the next restart.
migration_disabled_entry.title: Disabled router {host} was migrated

migration_failed.description:
The OpenWrt (ubus) entry for `{host}` could not be migrated to the main entry, so it was left in place. To retry the migration:

1. Check the Home Assistant log for the migration error and address its cause.
2. Restart Home Assistant to retry the migration.
migration_failed.title: Failed to migrate router {host}

migration_host_collision.description: The OpenWrt (ubus) entry for `{host}` was removed because a router with the same host is already configured on the main entry. The router continues to be tracked through the existing subentry; check its settings to confirm they are the ones you want, then dismiss this notice.
migration_host_collision.title: Duplicate router {host} was removed

migration_hub_reload_failed.description: The OpenWrt (ubus) entry for `{host}` was moved to the main entry, but the main entry could not be reloaded afterwards. Its routers may be untracked and the moved tracker ids may not be normalized; reload the main OpenWrt (ubus) entry to finish the migration.
migration_hub_reload_failed.title: Failed to reload main entry for router {host}

migration_polling_enabled.description: The OpenWrt (ubus) entry for `{host}` had polling disabled, but the main entry polls every router on it, so `{host}` is polled now. Subentries cannot carry a polling setting; if the router should not be polled, delete the `{host}` subentry and remove the router's `device_tracker` YAML configuration, as the legacy scanner re-imports it on the next restart.
migration_polling_enabled.title: Router {host} is now polled

migration_removal_failed.description:
The OpenWrt (ubus) entry for `{host}` was moved to the main entry, but the old entry could not be deleted. It has been emptied, so it no longer polls the router; its client trackers are kept on the main entry. To complete the migration:

1. Confirm the router is tracked on the main OpenWrt (ubus) entry.
2. Delete the OpenWrt (ubus) entry for `{host}`.
migration_removal_failed.title: Failed to remove old entry for router {host}

persistent_invalid_credentials.description: The username and password for `{host}` are no longer valid, so the router cannot be queried. Use "Change router" on the `{host}` subentry to update the credentials.
persistent_invalid_credentials.title: Invalid credentials for {host}

yaml_import_cannot_connect.description:
The YAML configuration for OpenWrt (ubus) at `{host}` could not be imported because the connection failed.

Please check that `{host}` is reachable, update your `configuration.yaml` if needed, and restart Home Assistant.
yaml_import_cannot_connect.title: YAML import failed: cannot connect

yaml_import_invalid_auth.description:
The YAML configuration for OpenWrt (ubus) at `{host}` could not be imported because the credentials were rejected.

Please check the username and password in your `configuration.yaml`, then restart Home Assistant.
yaml_import_invalid_auth.title: YAML import failed: invalid authentication
